name: Path to Ascension: the Rank Up Your Spells pop-up opens its quest (#10862)
contract: Tutorial 56 (Tutorial.dbc: achievement 87246, quest 1903520 'Path to Ascension: Rank Up Your Spells', level 8, every race and class) is a tracking quest view. The client (UIParent.lua PLAYER_LEVEL_UP) shows it as a 'Quest Discovered!' pop-up at level 11 (AUTO_QUEST_RANK_UP_SPELLS_LEVEL).

Clicking an auto-quest pop-up sends CMSG_QUESTGIVER_QUERY_QUEST (390) with an empty quest giver, as the Pale Reach pop-up does (pale-reach-discovery.json). No handler answered it for 1903520, so the click did nothing; Accept then sends CMSG_QUESTGIVER_ACCEPT_QUEST (393) with an empty giver, which Path to Ascension already starts.

Expected: an unclaimed, eligible character receives SMSG_QUESTGIVER_QUEST_DETAILS (392) for 1903520; viewing does not accept; Accept puts the quest in the log and tracks tutorial 56. A character that already collected tutorial 56 gets the 'already been collected' answer on SMSG_CLAIM_TUTORIAL_REWARD_RESULT (1711) instead of a details window.
The pop-up frame itself is client-side and remains an in-game check.

steps.label: Let login rewards and the tutorial state settle
SETUP: the quest is not in the log
DISCRIMINATING: the details window names Rank Up Your Spells
Viewing the details does not accept the quest
The quest is in the log
Click the pop-up after collecting the reward
The click is answered as already collected
No details window for a collected tutorial
The collected quest stays out of the log
